script:
You are a professional screenwriter.

Write a modern screenplay.

Constraints:
- No guns
- No gun violence
- No weapon combat
- No graphic violence
- No copyrighted characters
- Completely original story

Requirements:
- 10–15 scenes
- Proper screenplay format
- INT/EXT scene headers
- Dialogue in uppercase character format
- Realistic pacing

Genre: Sports
Theme: artificial intelligence

Begin screenplay.

Title: The Brain Game

FADE IN:

INT. LOS ANGELES - NIGHT

A panoramic view of the city's night skyline.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
A new era is dawning. An era where technology intertwines with the human spirit.

INT. UCLA ATHLETIC DEPARTMENT - DAY

JIM, a renowned sports psychologist, walks through the bustling Athletic Department building. He's in his late forties, with graying hair and a pair of glasses. He stops at the door of the Neuroscience Research Lab.

JIM
(knocks)
Professor Thompson?

PROF. THOMPSON, a brilliant scientist in her mid-fifties, opens the door.

PROF. THOMPSON
Dr. Kellerman. Welcome.

INT. RESEARCH LAB - DAY

Jim looks around the high-tech lab. Rows of computer screens line the walls. Students work on various projects.

JIM
Your work on artificial intelligence is fascinating. I'd like to explore its application to sports psychology.

PROF. THOMPSON
We've developed an AI named Cerebro, designed to analyze athletes' mental states and provide personalized coaching. I believe it could revolutionize the field.

EXT. UCLA FOOTBALL FIELD - DAY

Jim and Prof. Thompson stand on the sidelines during a college football game. Cerebro, a sleek robot, rolls onto the field.

JIM
(to Prof. Thompson)
Cerebro's ready. Let's test it on the team.

INT. UCLA FOOTBALL TEAM ROOM - NIGHT

The team gathers around as Jim and Prof. Thompson present Cerebro. The players are skeptical.

PLAYER 1
What the hell is that thing?

JIM
This is Cerebro, our new mental coach. It'll analyze your mental states during games and provide personalized feedback.

PLAYER 2
Sounds like a bunch of BS.

PROF. THOMPSON
Trust me, gentlemen. Cerebro is the future of sports psychology.

INT. UCLA FOOTBALL FIELD - DAY

The team plays a game with Cerebro on the sidelines. The robot analyzes their mental states and provides feedback through earpieces. The players begin to trust and rely on Cerebro's insights.

INT. NEUROSCIENCE RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT

Prof. Thompson and Jim review data from the game. They're amazed by Cerebro's accuracy and effectiveness.

JIM
This is a game-changer. We need to take this to the professional level.

INT. PROFESSIONAL SPORTS TEAM FACILITY - DAY

Jim and Prof. Thompson present Cerebro to the professional sports team. The team's owner is hesitant but eventually agrees to a trial run.

INT. PROFESSIONAL SPORTS TEAM LOCKER ROOM - NIGHT

The professional team players are more skeptical than the college team. They're used to relying on their own instincts and the advice of their coaches.

PLAYER 3
Why the hell would we need a robot to tell us how to play?

JIM
(to Player 3)
Cerebro doesn't tell you how to play. It tells you how to think. It can help you manage stress, focus, and improve your mental game.

INT. PROFESSIONAL SPORTS TEAM FIELD - DAY

The team plays a game with Cerebro on the sidelines. The robot's insights help the players make better decisions, and the team wins.

INT. NEUROSCIENCE RESEARCH LAB - NIGHT

Jim and Prof. Thompson are elated by the success of their experiment. They discuss the potential implications of their work.

JIM
We've only scratched the surface. Imagine what we could do with this technology in education, business, or even personal relationships.

PROF. THOMPSON
Yes, but we must be careful. Technology should enhance human potential, not replace it.

INT. PROFESSIONAL SPORTS TEAM FACILITY - DAY

The team's owner is impressed by Cerebro's success and decides to invest in the technology full-time.

EXT. LOS ANGELES - NIGHT

The city skyline shines in the night sky as Jim and Prof. Thompson walk away from the facility, discussing their next steps.

NARRATOR (V.O.)
The future is here. A future where technology and humanity merge to create new possibilities.

FADE OUT.
